title: Onboard a new employee
summary: After a hire is accepted and before the employee takes on their role and access. A completed role-specific onboarding plan with verified access, required training and an owned initial review.
outcomes: A completed role-specific onboarding plan with verified access, required training and an owned initial review.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: After a hire is accepted and before the employee takes on their role and access.

parts.title: Confirm the role, start conditions and private records
parts.guidance: Gather the accepted employment terms, manager, work location and approved start date. HR checks unresolved right-to-work, payroll or local prerequisites using the hiring process without copying sensitive identity records into a public checklist.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Prepare a role-specific onboarding schedule
parts.guidance: Plan introductions, first assignments, equipment, payroll and benefits handoffs, policy orientation and support contacts. Assign owners and clarify which tasks depend on the employee or an external provider.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Provision approved equipment and least-privilege access
parts.guidance: Authorized administrators use the workspace-user and device-management processes to grant only the approved role. Verify the employee can access required systems and that account recovery and asset ownership belong to the company.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Provision approved equipment and least-privilege access

parts.title: Complete orientation and supervised first work
parts.guidance: The manager introduces the team, expectations, safety and security reporting routes and role-specific practices. The employee completes their own required training and acknowledges policies through the applicable process.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Complete orientation and supervised first work

parts.title: Review readiness and close onboarding gaps
parts.guidance: Check the employee can perform an agreed initial task and knows how to get help. Record outstanding access or training, assign owners and schedule a manager review of objectives and support needs.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review readiness and close onboarding gaps

verify.how: A completed role-specific onboarding plan with verified access, required training and an owned initial review.
